subject: general
question: Where is a typical clutch actuated by a number of coil spring

options.text: On an addendum circle near the centre of the radius
On a pitch circle near the central axis of the shaft
On a base circle near the centre of the circle
On a pitch circle near the periphery

solution:
The correct answer is __On a pitch circle near the periphery.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A clutch__ is a device used to engage and disengage power transmission between the engine and the gearbox.
 
• It is typically actuated by a number of coil springs that ensure the required pressure for proper functioning.
 
• The coil springs are positioned on a pitch circle near the periphery to distribute the force evenly.
 
• This arrangement helps the clutch efficiently transmit power from the engine to the drivetrain.
 
• Its design ensures durability, efficient performance, and minimal wear and tear during operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Clutch Types:**

 
 
• Single-plate clutch: Used in cars and lightweight vehicles.
 
• Multi-plate clutch: Commonly used in motorcycles and heavy-duty vehicles.
 
• Centrifugal clutch: Automatically engages and disengages based on rotational speed.
 
 
 
• **Clutch Materials:**
 
 
• Commonly made from friction materials, such as asbestos, ceramics, or carbon composites.
 
• These materials ensure a firm grip and reduce wear and tear.
